text: Name 10 animals in 15 seconds — 1 sip per miss.
Say 'toy boat' 5 times fast — stumble once = 1 sip.
Balance a coin on your nose for 10 seconds — fail = 1 sip.
Do 15 push-ups without stopping — 1 sip per rep short.
Memorize 5 random items shown to you, look away, recite them — 1 sip per miss.
Say the alphabet backwards in 30 seconds — fail = 2 sips.
Whistle a recognizable song — group guesses in 30 seconds or you drink 1 sip.
Keep a completely straight face for 30 seconds while the group tries to make you laugh — laugh = 2 sips.
Name every player currently in the room in under 5 seconds — 1 sip per miss.
Attempt 3 cartwheels — refuse entirely = drink 3 sips.
Draw a portrait of the person to your right in 60 seconds — group rates 1–10; below 5 = drink 2 sips.
Arm wrestle the person the group picks — loser drinks 2 sips.
Do 20 burpees in 45 seconds — 1 sip per rep short, max 5.
Speak only in rhyme for 2 minutes — 1 sip per failure, each subsequent failure +1 extra sip.
Name 5 films starring an actor the group picks in 20 seconds — fail = 2 sips.
Hold a tree pose (yoga) for 45 seconds — 1 sip per stumble.
Build the tallest tower possible with 10 cups in 30 seconds — must stand for 5 seconds unassisted.
Tell a story incorporating 5 random words the group picks — minimum 60 seconds, group votes pass/fail.
Sing the full chorus of a song the group picks — 1 sip per line missed.
Mirror the movements of the person next to you for 90 seconds — they lead, you follow — diverge = 1 sip.
Finish the rest of your current drink in under 10 seconds — fail = group adds to it.
Let the group blindfold you and feed you a mystery item from the table — refuse = 5 sips.
Do 25 squats counting out loud — miscount or stop = 1 sip and restart from zero.
Group picks a word you must use naturally in every sentence for 5 minutes — each miss = 1 sip.
Speed trivia: group asks 5 questions, 8 seconds each — 1 sip per wrong answer.
Staring contest with whoever the group picks — first to blink drinks 3 sips immediately.
Hold a handstand against the wall for 15 seconds — fail = 3 sips.
Recite the chorus of 3 songs in 90 seconds — group picks all 3 — fail any = 1 sip each.
Stand on one leg for 60 seconds while someone reads you a distracting story — fall = 3 sips.
Group invents a secret handshake with you in 45 seconds — you must perform it flawlessly 5 minutes later — fail = 3 sips.
